name: Mettmann (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:5:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Mettmann (a yellow church and castle on blue).
history: The city flag bears the colours blue, white and blue striped horizontally in the ratio 1:5:1 with the city arms at the centre.

features.role: Mettmann arms — church and castle on blue
